questions.q: What is the maximum length of the Paper 1 summary?
questions.why: The summary must be no more than 120 words of continuous prose.

questions.q: How are the 40 marks for Paper 2 Section A (directed writing) split?
questions.why: Directed writing: 15 for reading, 25 for writing; 16 + 24 is the composition split.

questions.q: In Paper 2 Section B, the composition titles offered are:
questions.why: You choose one of four titles: two descriptive, two narrative.

questions.q: What is the difference between R1 and R2 in the reading objectives?
questions.model: R1 tests understanding of explicit meanings (what the text states directly); R2 tests implicit meanings and attitudes (what you must infer).
points: R2 = implicit / inferred meanings and attitudes
